title: Setting up recurring payments
summary: This document explains how to set up recurring payments: ensure you have fewer than 30 active schedules, set each payment amount up to $3,000, and schedule occurrences at least 4 days apart. It covers creation steps, common setup error fixes, and how to verify timing and future amounts.
